title: Server creation is temporarily paused
notice: Velora's server system is being rewritten to decentralize it. When the update is ready, you'll be able to host your own server or have Velora host it for you.
When the update launches, all existing servers will move to the Velora-hosted starter plan. You can upgrade or switch to self-hosting later.
Ember's source code may also become open source in the future, but this hasn't been decided yet.
